_note: Paintings behind conversations (DialogueStage). Each entry: scene is a SCENE_ID (home_floor1, bedroom_upstairs, town_square, cafe, florist, bookstore, exterior_home, ...); zone, optional, is a data/home_events.json area id (living_room, kitchen, north_room, entry_hall, bedroom_bed, ...) for a painting of one part of a room; image is the painting, a res:// path, best at 1920x1080 or 960x540. A zone's painting is used when Amelia stands in that zone, else the scene's own (an entry with no zone), else the room's picture around her, close up and softened. Example: {"scene": "home_floor1", "zone": "kitchen", "image": "res://assets/backdrops/home_kitchen.webp"}. Add paintings here as they are made; no code change is needed.
